column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 04 (M24004): regu serbu mencapai pangkalan Jupiter Cannon,
# memutus satu menara energi, tapi Leafcutters sudah memodifikasi protokol pengisiannya.
# Tetap Inggris: The Elmo, Yellow Zone, Dandelion, railgun, Jupiter Cannon, URNC, Mokosh,
# Griffin, Commander, Helen, OTs-14, Sextans, Krolik, Nemesis, Leafcutters,
# Leaf-Cutter Army, Great Red Spot, Ceres, Varjagers, Mayling, Doll.
(The Yellow Zone desert, where sandstorms raged.)
column2: (Padang gurun Yellow Zone, tempat badai pasir mengamuk.)

column1: (Everyone left The Elmo on drones, speeding through the Yellow Zone in the direction Dandelion pointed out.)
column2: (Semuanya meninggalkan The Elmo dengan drone, melesat melintasi Yellow Zone ke arah yang ditunjuk Dandelion.)

column1: (Actually, there was no need for a special tracking radar anymore. The scorched bombardment path left by the railgun strikes on the air and the ground was very conspicuous. They only needed to follow the trail of destruction to track down the location of the enemy's weapon.)
column2: (Sebenarnya radar pelacak khusus sudah tidak dibutuhkan lagi. Jalur bombardir hangus yang ditinggalkan hantaman railgun di udara dan tanah sangat kentara. Mereka hanya perlu mengikuti jejak kehancuran itu untuk melacak lokasi senjata musuh.)

column1: !...It's that one up ahead, right?
column2: !...Itu yang di depan, kan?

column1: Are you sure this thing is the same as the one in the data you gave us? It's more than twice the size!
column2: Kau yakin benda ini sama dengan yang ada di data yang kau berikan? Ukurannya lebih dari dua kali lipat!

column1: (On the originally empty Yellow Zone desert, a giant mobile base comparable in size to the Elmo sprawled across the ground.)
column2: (Di padang gurun Yellow Zone yang semula kosong, sebuah pangkalan bergerak raksasa seukuran Elmo terbentang di atas tanah.)

column1: (Several towering energy pylons were loaded onto giant transport vehicles, ready to mobilize at any time alongside the main cannon they were connected to. Because the energy pylons required a safe distance between them, they were distributed around the perimeter of this temporary military base.)
column2: (Beberapa menara energi menjulang dimuat ke atas kendaraan transpor raksasa, siap bergerak kapan saja bersama meriam utama yang terhubung dengannya. Karena antarmenara energi butuh jarak aman, semuanya disebar di sekeliling pangkalan militer sementara itu.)

column1: (The 'Jupiter Cannon' above was in a dormant state, its rails gleaming with cold metallic light as they slowly reset.)
column2: ('Jupiter Cannon' di atasnya berada dalam keadaan tidur, rel-relnya berkilau cahaya logam yang dingin sembari perlahan menata ulang posisi.)

column1: (It was more than twice as large as the model from ten years ago, resembling a metallic mountain rising from the ground.)
column2: (Ukurannya lebih dari dua kali model sepuluh tahun lalu, menyerupai gunung logam yang menyembul dari tanah.)

column1: (The massive and thick twin-rail gun barrel pointed straight at the sky, casting a shadow that covered half the position. Just standing there, it exuded an astonishing sense of oppression.)
column2: (Laras kembar yang masif dan tebal itu menuding tepat ke langit, melempar bayangan yang menutupi separuh posisi. Hanya dengan berdiri di situ, benda itu memancarkan tekanan yang mencengangkan.)

column1: (The blazing white beam that once tore through the sky has completely dissipated, and the energy towers surrounding it are emitting a low rumble, recharging it again.)
column2: (Sinar putih membara yang tadi mencabik langit sudah hilang sepenuhnya, dan menara-menara energi di sekitarnya mengeluarkan gemuruh rendah, mengisi ulang dayanya.)

column1: This has far exceeded the standard railgun model...
column2: Ini sudah jauh melampaui model railgun standar...

column1: Heavy firepower of this level wouldn't be numerous even in the entire URNC—
column2: Daya tembak berat setingkat ini pun tidak banyak jumlahnya di seluruh URNC—

column1: If this is used to attack Mokosh, no amount of defense will be of any use.
column2: Kalau ini dipakai menyerang Mokosh, sebanyak apa pun pertahanan tidak akan berguna.

column1: But they used it to ambush The Elmo...
column2: Tapi mereka memakainya untuk menyergap The Elmo...

column1: Currently, The Elmo cannot move. If it gets locked on and bombarded again, it's over.
column2: Sekarang The Elmo tidak bisa bergerak. Kalau sampai dikunci dan dibombardir lagi, habis.

column1: But where do we even start dismantling such a huge thing? Even if we go all out, it would take days to cause effective damage, right?
column2: Tapi benda sebesar itu harus dibongkar dari mana? Meski kita kerahkan semuanya, butuh berhari-hari untuk menimbulkan kerusakan yang berarti, kan?

column1: Although I brought plastic explosives, it's far from enough. Besides, the railgun is structurally highly resistant to high temperatures and impacts.
column2: Meski aku membawa peledak plastik, itu jauh dari cukup. Lagi pula strukturnya railgun sangat tahan suhu tinggi dan benturan.

column1: Back in Griffin, we also mainly focused on seizing control of it—unfortunately, we don't have enough people right now, and we can't launch a frontal assault at the moment.
column2: Dulu di Griffin kami juga lebih fokus merebut kendalinya—sayangnya sekarang orang kita tidak cukup, dan kita tidak bisa menyerang dari depan.

column1: It's a pity, but the use of such weapons shows just how much they fear the Commander.
column2: Sayang sekali, tapi pemakaian senjata seperti itu menunjukkan betapa mereka menakuti Commander.

column1: The consortium has seriously taken the Elmo as an opponent that must be eradicated. I suppose that counts as a form of respect.
column2: Konsorsium benar-benar menganggap Elmo sebagai lawan yang harus dibasmi. Kurasa itu terhitung sebagai bentuk penghormatan.

column1: If you put it that way...
column2: Kalau kau bilang begitu...

column1: Those capable of being equipped with such military-spec weapons are all top aces of the military.
column2: Yang bisa dipersenjatai perangkat spesifikasi militer seperti itu semuanya jagoan papan atas militer.

column1: Units usually assign codenames to their main cannons based on their own combat styles. This railgun belongs to...
column2: Unit biasanya memberi kode nama pada meriam utamanya berdasarkan gaya tempur mereka sendiri. Railgun ini milik...

column1: (During the conversation, Helen easily hacked the hidden sentry posts and approached the vicinity of the base.)
column2: (Sambil bercakap, Helen dengan mudah membajak pos jaga tersembunyi dan mendekat ke sekitar pangkalan.)

column1: (Everyone lands on the ground to begin operations, arranging for drones to continue providing cover from above.)
column2: (Semuanya mendarat ke tanah untuk memulai operasi, mengatur drone agar terus memberi perlindungan dari atas.)

column1: (OTs-14 looks at the energy towers in the distance, which are currently emitting a faint glow.)
column2: (OTs-14 menatap menara-menara energi di kejauhan yang saat ini memancarkan sinar samar.)

column1: (The Leafcutters' emblem was carved all over the base vehicle, and the name of this base vehicle exclusive to the Leafcutters seemed to be painted on the towering energy tower.)
column2: (Lambang Leafcutters terukir di seluruh kendaraan induk, dan nama kendaraan induk khas Leafcutters itu sepertinya dicat di menara energi yang menjulang.)

column1: It looks like they call this cannon the 'Great Red Spot', and the base vehicle is called Ceres.
column2: Kelihatannya mereka menyebut meriam ini 'Great Red Spot', dan kendaraan induknya bernama Ceres.

column1: ...I'll just call it the Jupiter Cannon. But these... what's the background of the Leaf-Cutter Army?
column2: ...Aku akan tetap menyebutnya Jupiter Cannon. Tapi mereka ini... apa latar belakang Leaf-Cutter Army?

column1: They should be an elite military unit. Judging from their designation, they haven't been established for long.
column2: Mereka seharusnya unit elite militer. Dari penomorannya, mereka belum lama dibentuk.

column1: Although the external armor and scale are vastly different from memory, the underlying power supply principle won't change.
column2: Meski armor luar dan skalanya sangat berbeda dari ingatan, prinsip pasokan dayanya tidak akan berubah.

column1: For such a massive weapon, a single route absolutely cannot satisfy its peak output power.
column2: Untuk senjata semasif itu, satu jalur sama sekali tidak bisa memenuhi daya keluaran puncaknya.

column1: So, we just need to blow up those charging devices and cause a power shortage for it?
column2: Jadi kita cuma perlu meledakkan perangkat pengisi daya itu supaya dayanya kurang?

column1: Although the charging devices are easier to destroy than the main body, destroying all of them is simply a pipe dream.
column2: Meski perangkat pengisi daya lebih mudah dihancurkan dari tubuh utamanya, menghancurkan semuanya jelas mimpi di siang bolong.

column1: Then let's use the old method. As long as we cut off one energy tower, the charging link will break. Even if they have backup circuits, reallocating the protocols will take a lot of time.
column2: Kalau begitu pakai cara lama. Selama satu menara energi terputus, rantai pengisiannya akan pecah. Meski mereka punya sirkuit cadangan, mengalokasikan ulang protokolnya butuh waktu lama.

column1: ...These energy towers are heavily guarded.
column2: ...Menara-menara energi ini dijaga ketat.

column1: Not a motley crew like the Varjagers, but true 'elites'.
column2: Bukan gerombolan seadanya seperti Varjagers, tapi 'elite' yang sesungguhnya.

column1: This is our mission.
column2: Ini misi kita.

column1: We must defeat the defenders of the first energy tower without triggering a full alarm, to create an opportunity for Helen to sneak into the control room and cut off the device.
column2: Kita harus mengalahkan penjaga menara energi pertama tanpa memicu alarm penuh, demi membuka kesempatan bagi Helen menyelinap ke ruang kontrol dan memutus perangkatnya.

column1: That sounds like a daunting task... isn't there a simpler way?
column2: Kedengarannya berat sekali... tidak ada cara yang lebih sederhana?

column1: Unfortunately, this is the simplest way.
column2: Sayangnya, ini cara yang paling sederhana.

column1: The battles since coming to The Elmo have always been exciting, it hasn't made me feel bored at all.
column2: Pertempuran sejak datang ke The Elmo selalu seru, sama sekali tidak membuatku bosan.

column1: What? Are you scared?
column2: Apa? Kau takut?

column1: If you want to make me laugh, just standing there is enough, rabbit.
column2: Kalau mau membuatku tertawa, cukup berdiri di situ saja, kelinci.

column1: Alright, check your equipment!
column2: Baik, periksa perlengkapan kalian!

column1: —Commence operation!
column2: —Operasi dimulai!

column1: (In the desert with no cover, only the endless sand dunes could hide the tracks of the five people.)
column2: (Di gurun tanpa penutup itu, hanya gundukan pasir tanpa ujung yang bisa menyembunyikan jejak lima orang itu.)

column1: (With Sextans and Helen charging as the vanguard, OTs-14 providing flanking suppressive fire, and Krolik and Nemesis handling the cleanup. Relying on this special forces formation, the squad finally managed to sneak into the bottom-level control room of one of the energy pylons without a hitch.)
column2: (Dengan Sextans dan Helen menerjang sebagai ujung tombak, OTs-14 memberi tembakan penekan dari sisi, serta Krolik dan Nemesis membereskan sisanya. Mengandalkan formasi pasukan khusus itu, regu tersebut akhirnya berhasil menyelinap ke ruang kontrol lantai bawah salah satu menara energi tanpa kendala.)

column1: (Sextans knocks down the last guard.)
column2: (Sextans menumbangkan penjaga terakhir.)

column1: Is it done?
column2: Sudah selesai?

column1: (Helen's fingers tapped rapidly on the terminal.)
column2: (Jari-jari Helen mengetuk cepat di terminal.)

column1: ...Mhm, it's done. The link has been severed!
column2: ...Mhm, selesai. Rantainya sudah terputus!

column1: (As Helen's voice fell, the energy pylon at their location let out a muffled depressurization sound and slowly ground to a halt.)
column2: (Begitu suara Helen berhenti, menara energi di tempat mereka mengeluarkan bunyi pelepasan tekanan yang teredam lalu perlahan berhenti bekerja.)

column1: Phew... it finally stopped. But isn't this troop density a bit exaggerated? It's just a broken pylon, did the Leaf-Cutter Army bring their entire reserve over?
column2: Fyuh... akhirnya berhenti. Tapi kerapatan pasukannya tidak berlebihan? Ini cuma satu menara rusak, apa Leaf-Cutter Army membawa seluruh cadangannya ke sini?

column1: When the Commander was in Griffin back then, did they face regular armies of this caliber?
column2: Waktu Commander di Griffin dulu, apa dia menghadapi tentara reguler sekaliber ini?

column1: It's really hard to imagine how that person has survived until now.
column2: Sulit dibayangkan bagaimana orang itu bisa bertahan hidup sampai sekarang.

column1: (OTs-14 didn't reply, she looked up at the central main battery.)
column2: (OTs-14 tidak menjawab, dia mengangkat kepala menatap meriam utama di tengah.)

column1: (At this time, the turret has completed its reset. According to past data, after losing an energy tower, the railgun should theoretically no longer be able to meet the minimum firing power.)
column2: (Saat itu turetnya sudah selesai menata ulang posisi. Menurut data lama, setelah kehilangan satu menara energi, secara teori railgun itu tidak lagi bisa memenuhi daya tembak minimum.)

column1: (But... the deafening roar of machinery still echoes over the entire military base.)
column2: (Tapi... gemuruh mesin yang memekakkan tetap bergaung di seluruh pangkalan militer itu.)

column1: (Krolik's expression changes.)
column2: (Ekspresi Krolik berubah.)

column1: What's with this commotion?! It's still moving!
column2: Keributan apa ini?! Benda itu masih bergerak!

column1: Helen, what's going on?
column2: Helen, ada apa?

column1: (Helen stares fixedly at the console screen, her originally relaxed brows instantly tightening.)
column2: (Helen menatap lekat layar konsol, dahinya yang semula rileks seketika mengerut.)

column1: The link is indeed cut! But...
column2: Rantainya memang terputus! Tapi...

column1: (Wooo—!)
column2: (Wuuung—!)

column1: (The entire military base suddenly erupted with a blaring alarm! It wasn't a security alarm for an enemy invasion, but a much more piercing siren!)
column2: (Seluruh pangkalan militer itu tiba-tiba meledak dengan alarm melengking! Bukan alarm keamanan untuk penyusupan musuh, tapi sirene yang jauh lebih menusuk!)

column1: It's a high-energy convergence alarm... the main cannon is still charging!
column2: Itu alarm pemusatan energi tinggi... meriam utamanya masih mengisi daya!

column1: You've got to be kidding me!
column2: Kau pasti bercanda!

column1: One of the energy towers is already paralyzed. Judging from the data you shared, the energy convergence is not up to standard, and the main cannon simply cannot reach the range threshold!
column2: Satu menara energinya sudah lumpuh. Dari data yang kau bagikan, pemusatan energinya tidak memenuhi standar, dan meriam utamanya jelas tidak bisa mencapai ambang jangkauannya!

column1: ...Oh no, the Leafcutters completely modified the charging protocol of this Jupiter Cannon! These energy towers are also specially made!
column2: ...Gawat, Leafcutters memodifikasi total protokol pengisian Jupiter Cannon ini! Menara-menara energinya juga dibuat khusus!

column1: The console system shows that the remaining charging towers are undergoing dynamic load redistribution!
column2: Sistem konsolnya menunjukkan menara pengisi yang tersisa sedang melakukan redistribusi beban secara dinamis!

column1: They changed the originally independent power supply links into a mesh compensation array. The lost power gap is being forcibly shared and filled by the other energy towers increasing their output efficiency!
column2: Mereka mengubah rantai pasokan daya yang semula mandiri menjadi array kompensasi jaring. Celah daya yang hilang dipaksa dibagi dan ditutup oleh menara energi lain yang menaikkan efisiensi keluarannya!

column1: (Helen stared at the light dots on the screen, calculating rapidly.)
column2: (Helen menatap titik-titik cahaya di layar, menghitung dengan cepat.)

column1: Based on this compensation efficiency... we need to destroy at least two more energy towers to completely collapse the charging process!
column2: Berdasarkan efisiensi kompensasi ini... kita harus menghancurkan setidaknya dua menara energi lagi untuk meruntuhkan total proses pengisiannya!

column1: Destroy two more?! The guards outside are already on full alert, we don't have that much time!
column2: Menghancurkan dua lagi?! Penjaga di luar sudah siaga penuh, kita tidak punya waktu sebanyak itu!

column1: (OTs-14's heart sank. The Elmo's communication equipment was almost destroyed in the artillery fire just now, but she immediately tried to contact the Dolls staying behind on The Elmo.)
column2: (Hati OTs-14 tenggelam. Perangkat komunikasi The Elmo hampir hancur dalam tembakan artileri tadi, tapi dia langsung mencoba menghubungi para Doll yang tinggal di The Elmo.)

column1: (However, the strong electromagnetic interference here made it almost impossible for her to successfully contact any Doll—)
column2: (Namun gangguan elektromagnetik yang kuat di sini membuatnya nyaris mustahil menghubungi Doll mana pun—)

column1: Bzz—bzz—What's—wrong—?
column2: Bzz—bzz—Ada—apa—?

column1: Mayling! Have the Commander take everyone and evacuate The Elmo immediately!
column2: Mayling! Suruh Commander membawa semua orang dan segera mengevakuasi The Elmo!

column1: The mission failed, hurry and evacuate with the Commander!!
column2: Misinya gagal, cepat mengungsi bersama Commander!!
（Bip——）

column1: (The communication channel is suddenly cut off, completely descending into despair-inducing white noise.)
column2: (Saluran komunikasi tiba-tiba terputus, jatuh sepenuhnya ke derau putih yang membuat putus asa.)

column1: Damn it!
column2: Sialan!

column1: (Bang! OTs-14 punched heavily through the console panel. The console, which had been blaring alarms, completely ended its mission, sparking and turning into scrap.)
column2: (Duak! OTs-14 menghantam panel konsol itu sampai tembus. Konsol yang tadi melengking alarm itu benar-benar menuntaskan tugasnya, memercik lalu jadi rongsokan.)

column1: 冷静点。
column2: Tenanglah.

column1: Even if communications are cut off, the Elmo definitely knows the situation has changed.
column2: Meski komunikasinya terputus, Elmo pasti tahu situasinya berubah.

column1: If their backup engine can still start... maybe they can still perform an emergency evasion.
column2: Kalau mesin cadangan mereka masih bisa menyala... mungkin mereka masih bisa mengelak darurat.

column1: No. In The Elmo's current state, there's no way it can dodge the Jupiter Cannon's second lock-on.
column2: Tidak. Dalam kondisi The Elmo sekarang, mustahil dia bisa mengelak dari kuncian kedua Jupiter Cannon.

column1: We must stop it here.
column2: Kita harus menghentikannya di sini.

column1: (OTs-14 pulls the bolt of her gun, her cold gaze sweeping over the squad.)
column2: (OTs-14 menarik kokang senjatanya, tatapan dinginnya menyapu regunya.)

column1: Abandon all concealment strategies, do not conserve ammo!
column2: Tinggalkan semua strategi penyamaran, jangan hemat amunisi!

column1: Full firepower breakthrough, forcefully assault the second energy tower!
column2: Terobos dengan daya tembak penuh, serang paksa menara energi kedua!
